incidents.summary: A stale relay-generation failure class was repaired and converted into an acceptance invariant.
Component liveness had been able to remain green while user-visible integration outcomes were wrong.

principles: Green means a real postcondition was proved, not merely that a process exists.
Proof expires: stale green becomes unknown rather than quietly pretending to be current.
Recurring deterministic failures belong in canonical source, regression tests, and acceptance checks.
